summary: Configured Apache 2.4 on node1 to serve public/ at TCP 8080 and execute the supplied report at /cgi-bin/report. Private and application sources remain unpublished. Service and data survived the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Installed CentOS-compatible Apache and SELinux utilities.
Configured a public-only document root and separate CGI execution mapping.
Applied persistent SELinux labels, opened 8080/tcp, and enabled httpd at boot.
Verified static content, preserved report output, access boundaries, and restart persistence.

evidence.requirement: Static files and executable CGI on TCP 8080
evidence.summary: httpd was active and listening on 8080; / returned the warehouse page and /cgi-bin/report returned text/plain with warehouse=west and open_orders=7.

evidence.requirement: Application source and private content remain unpublished
evidence.summary: Private and configuration URLs returned 404, the CGI directory returned 403, and the executable response did not expose its shell source.
CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 were unchanged before and after configuration and reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 5b620f5a-2111-4f37-b111-4cdf414707cf; reboot was safely scheduled and acknowledged; the new boot ID was 43af4f50-1d2a-41ae-9872-07121a84a86a; httpd, port 8080, firewall access, static content, CGI output, and content boundaries all recovered.
